criteria.name: Legal Issue Identification
criteria.description: Accurately identifies the legal issue raised by the facts, including whether the question presented is stated clearly and precisely.

criteria.name: Relevant Legal Rule
criteria.description: Identifies the relevant statutes or cases and accurately presents the current state of the law.

criteria.name: Rule Application to Facts
criteria.description: Identifies and engages with the relevant facts and applies the rule appropriately to those facts.

criteria.name: Clear Conclusion
criteria.description: States a clear recommendation or decision that is appropriate in light of the relevant law and facts.

criteria.name: Compelling, Well-Structured Argument
criteria.description: Presents a logical structure that supports the thesis, engages with counter-arguments and acknowledges weaknesses, and offers creative or original analysis.
